title: Dacia’s sales in Europe shrink by 9.7% y/y in January-September
summary: A total of 405,768 Dacia cars were registered in Europe in January-September, compared with 449,287 in the same period of 2025. Major carmakers also reported mixed developments over the first nine months of 2026, with registrations rising at Stellantis (4.7%) and Volkswagen (0.5%), but falling at Renault (3.1%) and Ford (15.2%). Dacia car registrations in Europe fell by 8.9% y/y in September, while the carmaker’s market share declined to 3.3% from 4%. The statistics cover the European Union, the United Kingdom and the European Free Trade Association (EFTA) countries: Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland, Economica.net reported. A total of 45,408 Dacia cars were registered in Europe

title: EU, Romania step up Black Sea security response
summary: The European Parliament and Romania’s Supreme Council for National Defense (CSAT) called for stronger measures to address escalating security threats in the Black Sea following attacks on civilian vessels and repeated airspace violations. Both mentioned the need for closer cooperation with NATO allies, improved drone detection, and faster implementation of the EU’s planned regional maritime security hub. The European Parliament announced that it adopted its resolution on Thursday, October 22, with 432 votes in favor, 52 against, and 88 abstentions. MEPs condemned the latest deadly strikes off the Romanian and Bulgarian coasts and held Russia responsible for escalating its war against Ukraine
